observations.model_input_provenance_note: Cutoff image only; following decision is outside selected event range.

decision.reason: Robot 0 and robot 1 each visibly carry a hem corner, with the yellow rim hanging between them. Lift together and gradually level both wrists to peel more of the shirt from the table while preserving both grips.

Both hem grips remain visibly engaged, while the hanging shirt is still near the tabletop. Level and straighten both wrists as the lift settles, increasing clearance and keeping the opening spread before transport.
Both robots visibly support separate hem corners, and the shirt appears clear of the tabletop. Back away together into the clear floor lane while preserving height and both grips.
Robot 0 and robot 1 retain their shared load. Stop base motion briefly and let the hanging garment settle before coordinating the turn toward the mannequin.
Robot 0 maintains its hem grip; robot 1’s hem is visibly wrapped around its rolled wrist. Pause transport and gently reverse robot 1’s roll while retaining both grips to unwind the cloth.
Robot 0 keeps its hem corner supported; robot 1 still has cloth wrapped around its wrist. Continue reversing robot 1’s roll at a steady rate, with both bases fixed and both grips retained.
Both hem corners appear retained. Hold robot 0 steady and continue unwinding robot 1’s wrist, keeping both bases fixed and grippers closed.
Both corners appear retained. Reverse robot 1’s remaining wrist roll toward neutral while robot 0 supports the opposite corner.
Hold both grips and let the wrist and suspended fabric settle before checking for residual twisting.
The wrist twist appears cleared and both hem corners remain supported. Begin a coordinated clockwise turn toward the mannequin while maintaining grip, height, and spacing.
Both hem corners remain supported during the turn. Continue rotating the pair clockwise with matched spacing, fixed arm height, and closed grips.
Both grips appear stable, and the mannequin is entering the right side of robot 0’s view. Continue the coordinated clockwise turn to bring it toward the center.
Both corners remain held and the mannequin is ahead. Stop turning and move the pair forward with a small leftward shift toward its front, keeping the garment raised.
Both corners appear retained and the garment remains suspended. Continue toward the front approach area while gently aligning the bases’ headings and reducing their stagger.

independent_visual_review.cooperative_lift_visual_support: Cloth remains near both separate grippers and rises above the table in selected public cameras. This is visual evidence, not contact-force or stable-grasp certification.
independent_visual_review.cooperative_turn_and_translation_visual_: Both head cameras retain cloth between grippers while the pair turns; observations 37 to39 and public base states show subsequent translation toward the visible mannequin. Arrival or dressing completion is not established.

roll_action_description_discrepancy.causal_status: command, measured rotation, visual wrapping and later recovery are observed; sole cause or unintended intent is not established
